title: Amblygon
summary: AM'BLIGON, or AM'BLYGON, noun [Gr. obtuse, and an angle.] An obtuse angled triangle; a triangle with one angle of more than ninety degrees.

inlines.v: AM'BLIGON, or AM'BLYGON, noun [Gr. obtuse, and an angle.] An obtuse angled triangle; a triangle with one angle of more than ninety degrees.
